say:1:1320609001:0.text: It's incredible that his body is made entirely of machinery. There's no flesh or blood at all.
say:1:1320609001:0.source_cn: 难以置信，这具躯体完全由机械铸成，甚至没有血肉成分。

say:2:1320609002:1.text: And you say he's really Callan, the heir to the Radinov family...
say:2:1320609002:1.source_cn: 他……他真是铐兰？拉季诺夫的长孙，家族的继承人？

say:3:1320609003:1.text: What happened to him? Why did he become like this instead of being resurrected as a Graveborn like you?
say:3:1320609003:1.source_cn: 他遭遇了什么，怎么会变成这样，而不是和你一样以亡灵的姿...

say:4:1320609004:1.text: Apologies, sir, but I don't know the details.
say:4:1320609004:1.source_cn: 十分抱歉，先生，具体情况我也不清楚。

say:5:1320609005:1.text: I wasn't there to witness when he was turned into a golem, but I'm fairly certain he's my brother, Callan.
say:5:1320609005:1.source_cn: 我没能目睹他变成机械人偶的全貌，但我很确定他就是铐兰，...

say:6:1320609006:1.text: Even though he looked a little frightening when I first saw him, he called me by my nickname.
say:6:1320609006:1.source_cn: 因为第一次见到他时，虽然模样十分骇人，但是他吱呀作响地...

say:7:1320609007:1.text: "Little Carly"... Only my parents and brother ever called me that. That's how I knew who he was.
say:7:1320609007:1.source_cn: 他叫我“小卡莎”……只有父母和哥哥才会那样叫我，所以虽...

say:8:1320609008:1.text: Miss Carolina, we found a book with this nickname on its title page. Does it belong to you?
say:8:1320609008:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜小姐，我们找到了一本书，它的扉页上写着这个名字...

choice_prompt:9:1320609008.text: Miss Carolina, we found a book with this nickname on its title page. Does it belong to you?
choice_prompt:9:1320609008.source_cn: 卡列琳娜小姐，我们找到了一本书，它的扉页上写着这个名字。它是不是属于你的？

say:10:1320609009:2.text: "The Mage and the Adventurer"... This is the storybook that my brother gave me when I was a child.
say:10:1320609009:2.source_cn: 《魔法师与冒险家》……这是小时候哥哥送给我的童话书……

say:11:1320609010:1.text: After I became a Graveborn, I returned here to my home and discovered that many of our possessions were destroyed in the war.
say:11:1320609010:1.source_cn: 我变成亡灵后再回到居所，居所已经变成了你们如今看到的废...

say:12:1320609011:1.source_cn: 请问，你们是在哪里找到它的？

say:14:1320609013:1.text: Good sir, you still haven't introduced yourself.
say:14:1320609013:1.source_cn: 先生，您还未曾告诉我您的姓名。

say:16:1320609015:1.text: You're Viscount Ludovic?! I remember grandfather used to look out to the garden and reminisce about his youth. He always spoke of how he missed conversing with you over tea.
say:16:1320609015:1.source_cn: 您……您就是柳博米尔子爵？！每到阳光明媚的下午，爷爷都...

say:17:1320609016:0.text: Every time your name came up, Grandfather's voice was filled with sadness. He often mentioned that you left too early. You were a very important friend to him.
say:17:1320609016:0.source_cn: 每次讲到您，爷爷语调中都浸染着沉痛。他惋惜您离开得太早...

say:18:1320609017:0.text: Eamon... Yes, even now, my memory of him has not faded.
say:18:1320609017:0.source_cn: 叶夫尼……是的，即便到现在，我对他的记忆也没有褪色。

say:19:1320609018:1.text: My time ended too prematurely. Though Eamon's legacy lives on in you and Callan, it's heartbreaking that you became a Graveborn and your brother a golem.
say:19:1320609018:1.source_cn: 我的时间过早地凝滞了，叶夫尼的生命虽然延续到你与铐兰身...

say:20:1320609019:1.text: It seems the gods have turned their backs on both our land and our kin.
say:20:1320609019:1.source_cn: 这片土地，还有我们的家族，似乎都已经被神明抛弃。

say:21:1320609020:1.text: My lord, the gods have not forsaken us. Because of their mercy, even though my brother has become like this, he was able to stay by my side for hundreds of years.
say:21:1320609020:1.source_cn: 子爵先生，神明并未忽视我们。因为他们的垂怜，哥哥即便变...

say:22:1320609021:1.text: For this, I am forever grateful.

say:24:1320609023:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and my lord Ludovic, if time has not stripped away your compassion, I beg you to aid my brother Callan.
say:24:1320609023:1.source_cn: 子爵先生，如果漫长的岁月还没有磨去您的怜悯，我恳求您，...
say:24:1320609023:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and my lord Ludovic, if time has not stripped away your compassion, I beg you to aid my brother Callan.
say:24:1320609023:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and my lord Ludovic, if time has not stripped away your compassion, I beg you to aid my brother Callan.

say:25:1320609024:1.text: I wish he could wake up and call me "Little Carly" again.
say:25:1320609024:1.source_cn: 希望他能清醒过来，然后再叫我一声……“小卡莎”。

say:26:1320609025:1.text: I have some understanding of magic that involves the soul and the human body, but Callan's soul inhabits a mechanical form. This surpasses my expertise.
say:26:1320609025:1.source_cn: 灵魂和肉体有关的魔法我略知一二，但铐兰灵魂的载体是纯粹...

choice_prompt:27:1320609025.text: I have some understanding of magic that involves the soul and the human body, but Callan's soul inhabits a mechanical form. This surpasses my expertise.
choice_prompt:27:1320609025.source_cn: 灵魂和肉体有关的魔法我略知一二，但铐兰灵魂的载体是纯粹的机械。这不在我的所知范围。

say:28:1320609027:2.text: Yes, Hugin is very proficient in mechanics and machinery. If anyone can discover what's wrong with Callan's body, it's him.
say:28:1320609027:2.source_cn: 对呀，呼金精通机械，也许他能检查出铐兰身上是不是零件出...
say:28:1320609027:2.male: Yes, Hugin is very proficient in mechanics and machinery. If anyone can discover what's wrong with Callan's body, it's him.
say:28:1320609027:2.female: Yes, Hugin is very proficient in mechanics and machinery. If anyone can discover what's wrong with Callan's body, it's him.

say:31:1320609029:1.text: He's a highly skilled dwarf artificer and craftsman. He's one of our traveling companions and is very trustworthy.
say:31:1320609029:1.source_cn: 是一位和我们一起旅行过的技艺精湛的矮人工匠，值得信任！

say:32:1320609030:1.text: In that case, please invite him to the manor.
say:32:1320609030:1.source_cn: 既然这样，那么，有劳各位请他前来庄园小坐吧。

say:33:1320609031:1.text: I hope we won't scare him off.
say:33:1320609031:1.source_cn: 希望我们这副姿态不会惊吓到他。

say:35:1320609032:1.text: Then, let's go get Hugin as fast as we can, Magister.
say:35:1320609032:1.source_cn: 那，主人，我们赶快叫呼金来帮忙吧！
say:35:1320609032:1.male: Then, let's go get Hugin as fast as we can, Magister.
say:35:1320609032:1.female: Then, let's go get Hugin as fast as we can, Magister.

narration:36:1320609033:1.female: After receiving your message, Hugin quickly arrives...
